votes.reasoning: Semver.swift:30 now calls comparePrerelease, which follows SemVer 2.0 section 11 rules: identifiers are split on dots, numeric ones compare as integers, numeric sorts below alphanumeric, and a longer list wins a tie. A trailing digit run is also split off, so beta10 > beta9. Reversal: restoring `sa > sb` made the beta10>beta9, beta9-not-newer and rc.10>rc.9 tests RED.

Semver.swift:34-67 replaces `sa > sb` with a SemVer 2.0 §11 comparator plus the documented trailing-digit split for this repo's dotless tags. Both helpers are private. The loop is one level deep with a switch, and each function is under 20 lines. The header doc was updated, so it no longer says 'lexicographic'. A digit run that overflows Int falls back to an alphanumeric identifier instead of crashing.

Sources/AiTaskbarCore/Util/Semver.swift:30-67 changes only the prerelease comparison. The public isNewer API is unchanged. The effect on consumers (UpdateChecker isNewer/newestPublished) is intended and documented in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
